I'm checking the user story against the quality criteria one by one. QUS-001 through QUS-003 pass: the role and action are present, there's a single requirement, and there are no extra notes. For QUS-004, the "so that I can complete my submissions" clause reads as a real purpose rather than another feature, so I'd count it as passing, though it's borderline. QUS-005 is where I'm at now, looking at whether it's framed around the problem.

I'm working through the remaining quality checks: QUS-006 through QUS-009 look acceptable, with the ZIP-format error reference and the "leave off the last 4 digits" wording reading clearly enough alongside the criteria. Then I'm moving on to the INVEST items, where independence, value, estimability and size all seem to hold.

I'm running through the DOR checks now: I don't see any evident external dependency, so DOR-001 looks not applicable, and the 5-digit, 9-digit and other cases are spelled out, so DOR-002 seems to pass. DOR-003 doesn't apply either, and since there's no title to assess, I'm estimating this as a small validation change, roughly a 1.

I'm settling on a size of 2 for this, since it needs validation changes across three ZIP cases and possibly some UI or test updates, even though it's on the small side. The "leave off the last 4 digits" wording looks odd at first, but the acceptance criteria make the intent clear. I don't see a real defect here, so I'm accepting the story.

I'm drafting the refined story in Spanish and writing out the acceptance criteria as observable rules: a 5-digit ZIP is accepted without errors or warnings, a 9-digit ZIP+4 is accepted, and any other digit count or letters trigger the existing ZIP format error.

Type is functional, and I'm checking whether anything here duplicates an existing item. Nothing turns up, so I'm marking it as registered.
